name: @pi-long-horizon/context
description: Long Horizon context inspection CLI/SDK and PI launcher.

scripts.build: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json && npx esbuild ../../src/context-steward/pi/pi-extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/pi-extension/index.js --external:better-sqlite3 --external:@earendil-works/pi-agent-core --external:@earendil-works/pi-ai --external:@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && mkdir -p dist/pi-extension/migrations && cp ../../src/thread/store/migrations/*.sql dist/pi-extension/migrations/ && npx esbuild ../../src/pi-extensions/codex-fast.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/pi-extensions/codex-fast.js --external:@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent && npx esbuild ../../src/pi-extensions/codex-web-search.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/pi-extensions/codex-web-search.js --external:@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
